input.quote: 4.1 License Fees. In consideration for the licenses granted to Corio pursuant to Section 2 of this Agreement, Corio shall pay the license fees specified in EXHIBIT B hereto. Payment terms of such license fees shall be as set forth in EXHIBIT B hereto.
input.rationale: Searches for most-favoured-nation formulations ("most favored", "no less favorable", "favorable/favourable", "lowest price", "best", "comparable", "discount", "other customers", "preferred") returned no hits. The fee and pricing provisions (Section 4 and Exhibit B pricing, revenue-sharing and payment terms) set fixed license, MarketSite.net access, maintenance, implementation and revenue-share amounts, with no obligation for Corio (our party, the licensee/customer) to extend Commerce One any terms it gives third parties or to match third-party offers. Exhibit D sales and marketing cooperation is expressly non-binding and contains no pricing-parity commitment. The preferred position — no MFN obligation on the Customer — is therefore met, and no Vendor-granted MFN exists to preserve, so no redline is warranted.
